_about: The nature-sound categories in the sound library (see each sound's 'category' field in data/manifest.json). Used only for the visuals (step 10): the text model embeds these descriptions and config/labels.json's descriptions with the same model, so each sound category can be compared with each image label — how well 'what we hear' and 'what we see' agree. Not shown to visitors, not sent to the LLM. Edit freely; takes effect on the next page load, no build step needed.
